title: Feeling Octomystic on 30A's Grayton Beach | Ocean Reef Resorts
meta_description: Step into a one-of-a-kind escape at this custom-built, octagon-shaped vacation home, where architectural brilliance meets coastal charm. Feeling Octomystic effortlessly blends style, comfort, and the natural beauty of Grayton Beach to create an unforgettable retreat for up to ten guests.
description_expanded: Step into a one-of-a-kind escape at this custom-built, octagon-shaped vacation home, where architectural brilliance meets coastal charm. Feeling Octomystic effortlessly blends style, comfort, and the natural beauty of Grayton Beach to create an unforgettable retreat for up to ten guests. Nestled near the heart of Grayton Beach’s historic village and just steps from the stunning Gulf, this unique residence is your gateway to paradise. The sleek, modern two-story home stands elegantly amidst a tropical oasis of live oaks, magnolias, pines, and palms, offering a private sanctuary that includes a serene private pool. The pool patio is the perfect gathering spot, complete with a screened porch, alfresco dining table, and gas grill for laid-back cookouts. Inside on the first floor, you’ll find a relaxed family room with coastal flair—featuring a large flatscreen TV, a daybed nook, and a queen-size sleeper sofa for flexible sleeping arrangements. A stylish wet bar with glass cabinetry, wine storage, and a beverage cooler adds convenience and character. This level also includes a spacious king guest bedroom and a full hall bath with a walk-in shower clad in elegant tile and stone. Just down the hall, a stacked washer and dryer with built-in storage make midweek laundry effortless. Ascend the spiral staircase to the sun-filled second floor, where open-concept living, dining, and kitchen spaces are wrapped in windows that frame tropical greenery. Double doors lead to a breezy sundeck with cushioned seating and alfresco dining areas on either side—ideal for morning coffee or sunset cocktails. The inviting living room features a wraparound sofa and vibrant decor, complemented by driftwood-style accents and coastal artwork. A round dining table and breakfast bar with woven stools create a natural gathering spot, while the well-equipped kitchen showcases custom cabinetry, glass-front uppers, and modern appliances. The second floor also hosts two beautifully appointed bedrooms. The serene primary suite offers a king-size bed, white coastal furnishings, and an ensuite bath with veined marble tile, a glass walk-in shower, and a sleek vanity. The nearby queen guest bedroom enjoys sunlit corner views and easy access to a full hall bath with a tub/shower combo. Beyond the home, the best of Grayton Beach is at your doorstep. Paddle across the nearby Coastal Dune Lake, stroll to the sugar-white sands of the Gulf, or explore nearly 2,000 acres of preserved trails and shoreline in Grayton Beach State Park—named one of America’s most beautiful beaches by Forbes Magazine . You're also just a short walk from Grayton’s iconic village scene. Grab a bite and a cocktail at The Red Bar , explore funky finds at The Zoo Gallery , or shop the latest surf styles at Tribe Kelley Surf Post . For tapas and live tunes, stop by Chiringo , or make it a night at AJ’s Seafood & Oyster Bar . With its showstopping design, peaceful setting, and unbeatable location, Feeling Octomystic isn’t just a beach house—it’s a vibe. Welcome to your Grayton Beach getaway.
